facts.condition: If receiver roles are interchangeable by channel relabelings and fixing the cloud auxiliary separates the coordinate-level satellite/input packets, then the best block Marton sum expression within that subclass is the sum of the one-use optima.
A two-use half-skew BSSC candidate above the additive one-use benchmark must retain dependence between coordinate packets after its cloud auxiliary is fixed.

For any selected tuple decomposition of a correlated block candidate, improvement requires the decomposition-specific correlation residual to pass the claim's strict balance test; passing that test alone does not establish improvement.

assumptions: All channel and auxiliary alphabets are finite.
The channel extension is memoryless and the blocklength is finite.
The standard private-message Marton sum functional is used.
The additivity conclusion is limited to the conditionally separated subclass and does not cover unrestricted correlated block laws.
